name: Core 2 HS
description: Core 2 High Stretch (HS) - the new reference amongst allround slackline webbing and the Landcruising masterpiece. This webbing delivers a whole bunch of innovative details. Perfectly balanced features allow you to push the limits. The HS version offers an extended stretch and is especially suitable for more dynamic applications like bouncy longlines. The higher stretch absorbs impact forces in the case of shock loads. Core - no limits!

name: Core 2 LS
description: Core 2 Low Stretch (LS) - the new reference amongst longline webbing and the Landcruising masterpiece. This webbing delivers a whole bunch of innovative details. Perfectly balanced features allow you to push the limits. The LS version offers the lowest possible stretch in the range of Polyester webbings and is especially suited for longlines beyond 100 m in length. The very low stretch reduces the tensioning way together with the time used to tension and thus results in a lower amount of rope required inside rope pulley systems. Lower stretch means lower stored energy too an added safety benefit. Core - no limits!

name: Core 1
description:
Core - the Landcruising masterpiece. This webbing is the essence of our experience in the longline sector. Perfectly balanced features let you push the limits.

The 4 ply construction with two inner and two outer layers guarantee a maximum of safety and provide long lasting protection against abrasion. The ultra low stretch saves energy while tightening longlines and the well balanced weight to strength ratio gives a precise dynamic with a powerful bounce.

Thanks to our new Gentle Edge Design and a fine weave, this webbing is very friendly to hands and knees while catching the line. We equipped the line with different colour traces on the opposite sides, this prevents twists in the line. The high-contrast color design provides excellent visibility over all terrains. Core - no limits!

name: Sonic 2
description: Sonic 2 - the legend is back! Unique polyamide webbing that was especially designed for all-round use in slacklining. This webbing is characterized mainly by the safe 3-layer structure, the very fine and robust weaving surface and the smooth rounded edges. The webbing is very soft and flexible, thus optimal to handle and has excellent pretensionability in weblocks. A special PU coating protects the webbing for a long time against abrasion and provides excellent grip underfoot.

name: White Magic
description: Our favorite line in the width of 25 mm / 1 inch. We use White Magic since 2006 for all our beautiful highline, longline and waterline projects. In our experience White Magic offers a superior combination of low elongation, high-strength, extended dynamic range, low weight and durability. The snow-white color with black contour borders ensures an optimum of visibility over all terrains.

name: Unicorn
description:
Unicorn is the new all-round slackline by Landcruising. We have placed special emphasis on safety, comfort and pleasant walking characteristics. Based on the webbing design of Core 2, we have implemented a new innovative edge design, which provides a distinctly noticeable softness. The so-called Soft-Cushion padding is located on both edges of the line and provides a significantly softer haptic under the sole of the foot. Soft Cushion also dampens the edge effect while catching the line. All in all, this offers a considerable comfort gain.

The core-sheath construction combined with the very fine fabric design guarantees high resistance to dirt and abrasion. The moderate weight of 61 g together with the high stretch of 9% at 10 kN ensures easy controllability and a lot of fun with dynamic movements like bounces and surfs. Unicorn is the ideal slackline webbing for versatile applications, whether Highline, Longline or Waterline.

name: Aero 2
description: Deluxe mid-stretch webbing. Bounce, surf, walk, and send!

name: Feather
description: An ultra-lightweight polyester webbing for low-tension and rodeo lines, a smooth black walking surface that stands out on any terrain and barely stretches, ideal for traveling slackliners who want a featherweight rig. Feather is absolutely not meant for highlines, main or backup.

name: Feather Pro
description: Lightweight and Stretchy Polyester. Ideal for low tension highlines

name: Mantra MK4 Flight
description: Low stretch for longline rigging. Built for those that love walking the big lines

name: Moonwalk
description: The Moonwalk is our high tech webbing - Made in France - The purpose was to offer to the slackliners an ultra light (34g/m) and ultra resistant (31kN) webbing to set up huge lines. She's also the solution for those who want to carry as light as possible when backpacking. It's a flat webbing, composed of 50% polyester/50% HMPE which gives it high resistance and low stretch. Light, easy to tighten and store!

name: Bluewing
description: Armed with the revolutionary Wing technology, this light-weight webbing is perfect for long- and highlining. Its low stretch makes it easy to tension longer lines, while the soft tubular edges prevent injuries when catching a highline. The successor of our popular on’sight line, the blueWing is also great for surfing.
notes: Elephant published three different stretch figures for blueWing: 3.6 % at 7 kN and 7.2 % at 15 kN (2012 product page, https://web.archive.org/web/20121016212106/http://www.elephant-slacklines.com:80/contents/en-uk/d104_bluewing.html); 7.2 % at 7 kN and 14.5 % at 15 kN (2014 meter-ware page, https://web.archive.org/web/20140609000002/http://elephant-slacklines.com:80/de/online-shop/zubehoer/meterware/meterware-blueWing-blau); and 5.9 % at 7.5 kN on today's shop page, which is the Wing 3.5's figure. The curve held here matches the 2014 page at 15 kN.

name: Sigma N
description: Jormungand - the snake. Soft, smooth, snappy. The first polyamide webbing of slackliner / sigma Slacklines The soft and very flexible hose band is very easy to catch due to the thick edges, so it works well for Water and highlines. Also for longlining, it is up to 100m suitable. An ideal exercise webbing

name: Sigma Impact
description: When two worlds collide! Our new flat polyester webbing Impact has been manufactured in a way that combines the best qualities of PES and PAD in one slackline. It has PAD's high stretch for powerful bounces, endless surfing and a dynamic walking experience whilst being made entirely of PES for high abrasion resistance and to remain affordable for the broke slackliner you surely are. The quality weave has rounded edges for more comfort on your feet and hands. Combined with the high energy absorption and a more than decent break strength it is the perfect highline webbing. We use a digital printing process to ensure brilliant colours. Polyester has never been so good. The Sigma Impact. Try it now.

name: Dragon
description: This re-dressed three-tonner is timeless. Several Czech records were broken on this line. Multi-layer design provides sufficient strengths even for lines over 100m.

name: Bounce
description: The enthusiast’s line. Highly addictable webbing with excellent stretch suitable for travelling and dynamic tricks alike.

name: Element
description: Tubular 25 mm webbing designed for progressive tricks, surfing, and jumps alike. High stretch destined the webbing for dynamic tricks application, as well as rode line. Thinner tubular webbing can be threaded through the Element to create an extremely strong and yet quite stretchy line.

name: Skye
description: A lightweight 3,5ton polyester webbing that boasts with “core/weave” and extra rounded edges. No detail was omitted.

name: eLine
description: The YogaSlackers eLine webbing is perfect for beginner to advanced slackliners. This versatile 1” line offers lower tension for a safe and fun way to work both static and dynamic poses.

name: Cobalt
description: The COBALT is slack mountain's classical webbing. 49g/m for all kinds of uses. With 25 kN Breaking, it will be use in all domains.

name: Snake Tub
description: The tubular webbing 25 mm of Slack-Mountain, realized in Polyester, her will be completed for those who look for a comfort under the foot. His elasticity will allow to make you the a little harder spot. Thanks to his black central line on a single face you can make the flat easily. With 52g / m.

name: Diablo2
description: The DIABLO 2 with new weaving and new color, it is the webbing which is going to torment you, with its 96 g/m the difficulty will be supreme. In case it would not be sufficient we can always double it and find itself with 192g / m. The webbing is weaved from fiber tinged in the mass so that over time it remains devilish.

name: Goku 2
description: The GOKU 2 Hybrid 2.5 cm Slack Mountain, high performance composed of high-tech fiber webbing, light and very strong to do all your lengths and beat your records. With 41g/m you can take it everywhere and will also practice on your short lengths as a travel your webbing.

name: Spectre
description: The webbing polyamide which will make you discover a New World, with its design in soul + girdle and his round edges, it will offer you a flexibility and a unique elasticity. His 70 g/m and his resistance of more than 30 kN shall allow you to take advantage of his 13.5 % of elasticity even low-voltage. Made in France

name: Wallaby
description: Our Wallaby trickline, is the bounciest yet. A high breaking strength. The low initial elasticity is then met by the dynamic reserve and is ideally rigged with pulleys, but can just as easily be setup on ratchets. The extra thickness compared to most lines is from the increased resistance allowing you to get more height to help stick new tricks.

name: Plum
description: One of the webbing most light of the market with 25g / m it will be completed to be taken in kits light. Ideal during the travels.

name: Cosmic
description: COSMIC is semi-challenging tubular webbing, known for its strength, light weight, and smooth edges. It offers a great bounce with limited stretch, making it ideal for longlining in parks and safe for highlining. COSMIC's unique smoothness and specific stretch make it excellent for both static and dynamic trick training.
notes: Slack Inov / Spider 2026 datasheet (2026-09-02): MBS 80 mm diverter 31.0 kN; 3σ MBS weblock 27.4 kN; 3σ MBS sewn loop 28.7 kN; 3σ MBS linelock ring 28.7 kN; 3σ MBS after 6 months outdoor exposure 20.5 kN; energy absorption capacity 2003 J/m; min rigging length 26 m highline / 50 m SPLIT 50 / 100 m SPLIT 100.

name: Donkey
notes: Slack Inov / Spider 2026 datasheet (2026-09-02): MBS 80 mm diverter 32.0 kN; 3σ MBS weblock 30.7 kN; 3σ MBS sewn loop 33.7 kN; 3σ MBS linelock ring 33.7 kN; 3σ MBS after 6 months outdoor exposure 22.8 kN. notes: Slack Inov / Spider 2026 datasheet (2026-09-02): MBS 80 mm diverter 27.0 kN; 3σ MBS sewn loop 25.0 kN; 3σ MBS linelock ring 25.0 kN; 3σ MBS after 6 months outdoor exposure 17.0 kN; energy absorption capacity 2669 J/m. Neither price is verified and the product is discontinued. The product page linked here previously (https://slack-inov.com/gb/longline/145-nova) now 404s; the shops no longer carry it.

name: Rainbow
description: The Unicorn won't fly anymore. Let’s dance on the Rainbow now! Rainbow is the next generation highline webbing. Its rounded edges and the tight weave make it feel very soft and smooth to your hand and feet. Take a look at the stretch characteristics: it’s easy to tension but still playful enough for nice surfbounces and bouncetricks. The dual color design helps you to prevent twists while taping and rigging. Rainbow is coated for protection against water, dust and dirt, so you will have long time fun with this webbing.
notes: Specs from raed webbing manual Annex A. loop MBS 32 kN; DLV MBS 26 kN; ISA strength class A

name: Parsec
description: Parsec is our awesome Polyester Webbing for all your ambitious longline and highline projects. Its low stretch makes it very easy to tension which is ideal for longlines from 100 m and more.
notes: Specs from raed webbing manual Annex A. loop MBS 32 kN; ISA strength class A

name: MOTM
description: Have you seen the man on the moon? We have and he was looking amazing. Bouncing weightless between the stars and the earth in an endless flow. This extraordinary fabric will give you some alien fun right where you choose the experience to take place - even without NASA's budget. The sky is not the limit, your imagination is. And fun is what you make of it. That’s the truth about this fantastic webbing. Your turn.
notes: Specs from raed webbing manual Annex A. MBS 26 kN, WLL1 5.2 kN (SF=5), WLL2 8.7 kN (SF=3); loop MBS 23 kN, TypeX MBS 13 kN; 25mm Nylon tube, 56 g/m; recommended highline length 100m, backup surplus 18%. Stretch: 20-point measured curve retained (reads 11.5% @5kN); note the manual quotes 14.3% @5kN — the two disagree, likely different production versions.

name: Helium
description: Helium is some very interesting slackline webbing. With its 38 g/m it is very lightweight. With its stretch of 3% at 8 kN it is very low stretch as well. Third it is some very flat webbing. This makes it packing very small. This combination makes it an ideal choice for your travel webbing because you have a lightweight webbing that's very easy to tension and packs very small in your travel package. With a minimum breaking strength of 24 kN Helium is strong too. You can use it for your low tension longline projects as well as for waterlines or lowlines.
notes: Specs from raed webbing manual Annex A. loop MBS 22 kN; TypeX MBS 13 kN

name: Cumulus
description: CUMULUS is the fluffy roundhouse ass kick for your bouncy sessions! Soft, round, thick, smooth edges make it perfect for your bare feet and catches. With a weight of just 66g/m but 35 kN strength plus robust core/sheath design this webbing is also perfect for your remote highline spots. And the best of it: More than 8% stretch at 5 kN combined with a therma stretch/hydro shield covering makes your bounce sessions smoother and more controlled than ever before. This awesome new fluffyness feels like walking and bouncing on fluffy cumulus clouds. You will love it!

name: pinkTube
description: Just WOOWOWOOOOOOOW! That’s how it feels like when you first time walk on a pinkTube. This webbing is the stretchiest and bounciest line available. No matter whether you just want to walk or do crazy tricks, the pinkTube guarantees endless fun.

name: redTube
description: The perfect feel-good slackline. The polyamide (= nylon) redTube is the perfect slackline for anyone who likes soft, high-stretch webbing. Version A is certified according safety standard ISA 41.

name: Marathon
description: The Marathon is a high-tech polyester webbing designed with low stretch and soft edges. Its pleasant dynamics ensure perfect performance and an exceptional walking experience. In addition to these outstanding qualities, this classic webbing is now an ISA Certified Highline Webbing, classified under Strength Class A.

name: Half-Marathon
description: HighTech polyester webbing with low packing mass and weight. Which is perfect for alpine products as main or backup line. The low weight also makes it easy to control for longline tricks like bouncing or surfing.

name: Tender
description: TENDER is a webbing specifically produced for longline set-ups, its light polyester fiber was designed to create a tender walking experience.
notes: Slack Inov / Spider 2026 datasheet (2026-09-02): MBS 80 mm diverter 23.0 kN; 3σ MBS weblock 21.4 kN; 3σ MBS sewn loop 20.9 kN; 3σ MBS linelock ring 20.9 kN; 3σ MBS after 6 months outdoor exposure 20.4 kN; energy absorption capacity 2482 J/m; min rigging length 11 m highline / 50 m SPLIT 50 / 100 m SPLIT 100.

name: Fly
description: Our FLY line is a strong and quite resisting webbing with its high breaking strength (33 kN) and its simply flat woven character. Even though it's very strong, it is also a very lightweight line and therefore ideal for those who are ready to rigg 30+ m set-ups.
notes: Slack Inov / Spider 2026 datasheet (2026-09-02): MBS 80 mm diverter 33.0 kN; 3σ MBS weblock 32.3 kN; 3σ MBS sewn loop 30.4 kN; 3σ MBS linelock ring 30.4 kN; 3σ MBS after 6 months outdoor exposure 29.6 kN; energy absorption capacity 2300 J/m; min rigging length 14 m highline / 50 m SPLIT 50 / 100 m SPLIT 100.

name: Zao
description: ZAO is a highly appreciated slackline: it was designed based on feedback from some of our best longline and highline athletes. A flat woven central body and tubular edges ensure simultaneously softer catching and handling for the hands and a solid line feeling underneath your feet.
notes: Slack Inov / Spider 2026 datasheet (2026-09-02): MBS 80 mm diverter 31.0 kN; 3σ MBS weblock 30.3 kN; 3σ MBS sewn loop 29.1 kN; 3σ MBS linelock ring 29.1 kN; 3σ MBS after 6 months outdoor exposure 27.0 kN; energy absorption capacity 3392 J/m; min rigging length 10 m highline / 50 m SPLIT 50 / 100 m SPLIT 100. The datasheet's stretch continuation above 20 kN is a second test run reading below the first, so only the 1-20 kN series is stored.

name: Edge
description: EDGE is a polyester webbing made of three woven layers: a high-resistance central core (35 kN MBS) and two soft edge layers for a gentle feel even under high tension.
notes: Slack Inov / Spider 2026 datasheet (2026-09-02): MBS 80 mm diverter 35.0 kN; 3σ MBS weblock 32.7 kN; 3σ MBS sewn loop 34.1 kN; 3σ MBS linelock ring 34.1 kN; 3σ MBS after 6 months outdoor exposure 31.0 kN; energy absorption capacity 2600 J/m; min rigging length 10 m highline / 50 m SPLIT 50 / 100 m SPLIT 100.

name: Jumbo
description: The idea for the JUMBO line originated from a desire to practice and train on a heavier webbing. Our development process allowed us to come up with the innovative solution; to create a tubular webbing with the strength of a heavy webbing (83g). JUMBO is the first longline with external tubular and interior flat weaving. This combination creates an amazing three layers longline that demands real dedication.
notes: Slack Inov / Spider 2026 datasheet (2026-09-02): MBS 80 mm diverter 35.0 kN; 3σ MBS weblock 29.6 kN; 3σ MBS sewn loop 33.3 kN; 3σ MBS linelock ring 33.3 kN; 3σ MBS after 6 months outdoor exposure 27.0 kN; energy absorption capacity 3290 J/m; min rigging length 10 m highline / 50 m SPLIT 50 / 100 m SPLIT 100.

name: Nylove
description: NYLOVE is the product of extensive research and development to create an ideal highline slackline. Featuring a tubular core of nylon polyamide, it is shiny, bright, and soft. The solid central woven core achieves an MBS of 30 kN(6,744 lbs).
notes: Slack Inov / Spider 2026 datasheet (2026-09-02): MBS 80 mm diverter 31.0 kN; 3σ MBS weblock 27.2 kN; 3σ MBS sewn loop 26.2 kN; 3σ MBS linelock ring 26.2 kN; 3σ MBS after 6 months outdoor exposure 22.5 kN; energy absorption capacity 4443 J/m; min rigging length 10 m highline / 50 m SPLIT 50 / 100 m SPLIT 100.

name: Y2K
description: The Y2K is a groundbreaking high-tech webbing – actually a highline system with perfectly optimized backup length that is connected every 50/100m to the main line. Unlike most other high-tech webbings, the Y2K can be used in a single wrap in weblocks. The Y2K is an ISA Certified Highline Webbing, classified under Strength Class A.

name: Tape
description: Ideal webbing for all kind of slackline

name: Ninja
description: Vicious 35 mm line designed for extreme trickline shows. Trickline specialty is what we call it. The line is designed to be used with Katana locker in extreme trickline shows and competitions. The Ninja is an extra strong and dynamic line for massive flights.

name: Slim Green
description: The Slim is a lightweight webbing that has found its ground in tensioning systems. Enthusiasts however use it for special slackline styles such as rodeo line.

name: Emeraude
description: Designed on the advice of Nathan Faure Vincent, who obviously tried and validated it, Emeraude webbing is made for hight level practice.

name: Dark Blue
description: Slack.fr's "Superflat" webbing in dark blue: 100 % polyester, flat, marketed as general purpose - shortline, longline and highline - and recommended above all for longlining. The maker's own strong points: strong and long-lasting, with no sharp edges, soft and comfortable underfoot. Sold as made-up lines in 25 m, 50 m and 100 m.
notes: Specs from Slack.fr's own shop page as captured 2014-08-29; product_url is that Wayback capture, because shop.slack.fr is long gone (Slack.fr's catalogue is now carried by Slack Inov) - hence active false. The capture confirms, unchanged, the four figures this row already held from the SlackDB import: flat, 100 % polyester, 25 mm, 62 g/m, MBS 28 kN. Two things it adds. (1) Elongation: the maker states 5.5 % at 15 kN, recorded as a second stretch point beside the inherited 4.7 % at 10 kN - two single quoted figures, not a measured curve. It is set here to 1.45, the 100 m line this capture is the page for, matching the 2FACES entry's rule of taking the longest length's regular price; the ladder is recorded above so the other tiers are not lost. Prices include the made-up line, not bulk webbing by the metre. The maker calls the product Superflat "Dark Blue"; the catalogue name stays "Dark Blue" because the id and name are already recorded elsewhere. Polyester at 28 kN derives Type B.

name: EcoLine
description: You cannot get any more basic than that. No colour, no accessories, but 100 % fun at an unbeatable price. We saved on everything but the necessary – the quality of the slackline and the ratchet. The fantastic price/performance ratio is perfect for quality-conscious beginners. The no-frills 12 meter long ecoLine is our lightest product and is ideal to take on trips.

name: Wing 3.5
description:
The Wing 3.5 is the ultimate all-rounder for beginners, advanced slackliners and pros. Even during your first steps on a slackline, you will notice the pleasant dynamics of this webbing. The integrated Wing technology causes the tubular edges of the slackline to adapt to the sole of your foot. With a width of 35 mm/1.4", the webbing forgives mistakes while walking. The considerable elasticity of the webbing allows ambitious jumps even at short distances.

At the same time, the Wing 3.5 is excellent for longlines of up to 50 m (165 ft) in length. Those of you who are into surfing, will absolutely love this line - its high elasticity allows for great surfs even on shorter lines.

There's no way around this webbing!
notes: Price is per meter from Elephant's 2015 meter-ware page, which also gives 54 g/m: https://web.archive.org/web/20150416011603/http://elephant-slacklines.com:80/de/online-shop/zubehoer/meterware/meterware-wing-3.5-orange

name: Flow Line
description: The FLOW LINE is ideal for all longliners or those who strive to go the distance. Thanks to the low flexibility, the amount of webbing to be pulled out for tensioning is very little. Due to its direct power transmission the FLOW LINE is also suitable for distances up to 150 m. Its weaving technique makes it a reliable slackline withstanding everyday wear by our professional athletes.

name: Tube Line
description: The Gibbon Tube Line Set is a Slackline with 25mm running width, which is equipped with a tubular tape. This tubular tape has very soft edges and is very comfortable to run on.

name: Verve 35mm
description: The 35 mm wide slackline with soft touch and extended stretch gives more surface under the feet and fantastic dynamic pleasure, even on shorter lines. This webbing is ideally for beginners, recreational use and jumpliners.

name: Matrix
description:
The Matrix jumpline is the benchmark for tricklining with an extremely dynamic and powerful rebound. The unique combination of high breaking strength, high stretch and a big safety margin while pretension with high power guarantees a new quality regarding flight level and airtime and set back every other known.

The line needs to be very tight (beyond 10kN) for powerful jumplining. So far a high risk (line break, snap) was involved. Trickling with the Matrix is more safe due to the redundant tube in tube double line approach and the high break strength in absolute and relative meanings (Matrix is world leading in jumpline strength).

100% Polyamide guarantee in contrast to the known Polyester lines a pressureful dynamic without lower death point. The rich and full thrust until take-off provides pure bounce experience. The webbing width of 32mm gives better foot placement und jump precision. The great mass inertia and damping characteristic of threaded lines ensure more time and tolerance for dynamic control.

Matrix - unleash your power!

name: Matrix Outer
description: The Matrix Outer webbing can be used in many different ways. It offers as single line very good dynamic properties on shorter distances. The Matrix Outer transforms into a powerful jumpline by reinforcing it with 25 mm polyamide webbing. And lastly the 32mm wide webbing is suitable as protection padding for 25 mm lines.

name: Wave Tube
description: Slackline was born on nylon tubular webbing back in the early eighties. The soft touch and the fine weave give a genious dynamic and balance feeling (thanks to the Nylon fibers). This webbing will guarantee pure slackline fun. Even for moderate longlines suitable if threaded with our 19mm Wave-Tape.

name: Wave Tube 19
description: This 19 mm wide tubular webbing is very suitable for making a threaded leash. 10 mm to 10,5 mm dynamic rope fits ideally inside and giving a highline leash with superiour handling and strength. The webbing is additionally suitable as single walking line or reinforcement for 25 mm tubular webbing.
notes: Specs from the maker's page (Wayback 2013-04-15): PA tubular, 19 mm, 2.4 mm, average break strength 17 kN, min. 16 kN, 14 % at 6 kN and 32 % at break, 36 g/m, made in the EU. 'Wave Tape 19' (#117, flat, 18 kN, 38 g/m, no source link) was the same product in red and was merged into this row on 2026-10-07; its photo moved across, and where the two disagreed the Wayback page won.

name: Sigma Impact LS
description: The popular Sigma Impact webbing - now in a low stretch version. For everyone who has been put off by the high stretch of the Impact so far: the same soft webbing, with low stretch. Soft and comfortable in the hand, hardly any edges thanks to the webbing thickness. An ideal longline webbing with only 4 % stretch at 10 kN. Deliberately undyed: the webbing is pure, brilliant white.

name: Octopussy MKV
description: The timeless classic from Slackhouse. All round slackline webbing used by beginners and professionals. Basic yet versatile polyester webbing mostly valued for pleasant bounce combined with low weight and high strength.

name: Rubber Band MKIII BLU
description: A classic, flat, nylon (polyamide) webbing with high stretch and incredible energy. Created to fulfill dreams of sky-high bounces and wild surfs. Do not get scared of high stretch demanding more effort while tensioning - end result is worth it. Rubber Band works perfectly at short highlines introducing more bouncy feeling also increasing their safety margin. Yet it gives the most fun at medium lengths even at low tension.

name: Rubber Band MKIII SOL
description: A classic, flat, nylon (polyamide) webbing with high stretch and incredible energy. Created to fulfill dreams of sky-high bounces and wild surfs. Do not get scared of high stretch demanding more effort while tensioning - end result is worth it. Rubber Band works perfectly at short highlines introducing more bouncy feeling also increasing their safety margin. Yet it gives the most fun at medium lengths even at low tension.

name: Blue Mile
description: Blue Mile is a strong and lightweight polyester webbing aimed for longlining. It's main advantage is very low elongation - tensioning even longer lines requires less effort and shorter tenstioning systems. High strength provides better safety margin. Reasonable choice for highline backup.

name: Slack-Spec 11/16"
description: By the Meter. A soft, stretchy 11/16" tubular built for short park lines and rodeo lines.

name: CoreTek
description: CORETEK takes standard tubular webbing to the next level with a second piece of polyester webbing threaded through the center. This gives the line a supportive core offering a solid, but responsive feel ideal for slacklining.

name: Sugoi
description: SUGOI (pronounced "sue-GOY") meaning awesome, is a flat polyester webbing with low stretch and high strength; the perfect weave for long and highlines.

name: Great White
description: This is South Africa’s first ever Slackline-Specific Webbing – made for longlining and highlining

name: Tantalus
description: It's time to smile and share the happiness. Tantalus, polyester webbing is here and it comes with a record weight of just 53g /m, so light you can control the line at any length. The newly designed weave is developed to provide an unforgettable slackline experience in any scenario, whether you are cruising in the park high in the air. Rounded edges take away the need to worry about catching, sharp edges, cuts, and bruises, just relax and enjoy. Even better, this webbing is called the "red carpet" of all polyester slackline webbing. The softness and beautiful light feeling will keep you on the line forever. The stuff, dreams are made of.

name: Type 18 CG4
description: Like the mystery of how globule CG4 was formed, Balancing Earth is seeking the mystery of what pushes us to try new things. This is why we chose to name our 1 inch flat webbing after the mysterious. Type 18 CG4 is a flat nylon webbing made from the highest quality 66 nylon available. Type 18 CG4 is extremely soft and dynamic making it the perfect slackline webbing. With it's high stretch* and super strength the CG4 webbing is a great choice no matter what type of slackin you do.

name: Rasta Tubelar
description: Tubular webbing is the type of webbing that started the sport, back in Yosemite Valley in the 80's. Balancing Earth kept that in mind when putting together our tubular webbing. Balancing Earth's 1" slackline tubular webbing is made from top quality nylon threading. Our slackline tubular webbing is super soft and the bounce is incredible. Making it perfect for every aspect of the sport whether surfing, walking, yoga, even tricks (under the right tension), our slackline tubular webbing is the best. The quality of the nylon fibers and the weave of the construction make it the softest slackline webbing available.

name: Flat
description: 50 meters of 25mm wide flat polyester webbing.

name: Sky Pilot (Black/White)
description: Get ready for the ride of your life. Introducing SlacklifeBC's new nylon webbing, Sky Pilot - a line that transforms walking into flying. Taking control and floating in the air on this webbing is a chance to create your own aerial playground. Like to surf, bounce and dance 1000ft up in the air? Sky Pilot is your new friend. And, as any good friend would, it will catch you in the most gentle way possible with its soft, silky smooth edges. You guys are going to have a lot of fun!

name: Lion Line
description: High Tech does not equal high maintenance anymore! Experience the perfect relationship with SlacklifeBC’s new high tech webbing. Lions is a no-fuss rig. It holds with one wrap in a weblock and grips with the linegrip allowing you to pretension at any time. Light as a cloud at 35 g/m and firm but soft on your feet, it is the perfect support for your long journeys across mountains, canyons, cities or just in the park. The search is over, Lions is the one! Designed and manufactured in Canada offers you the chance to own the longest piece of webbing available. Lengths of over 1000 meter continuous is now reality. Turn your dreams into reality and experience the Lions for yourself.
notes: Specs from Slacklife BC's own product page (Wayback, 2017-10-08): MBS 35.6 kN (8000 lbs), WLL 7.12 kN (1600 lbs), 35 g/m, price 8.99 CAD/m (also sold by the foot, and in 50-1000 m lengths), colour red and white, designed and made 100% in Canada, continuous lengths over 1000 m. The page gives stretch only as "1-4%" with no load, so no stretch curve is recorded. A second Slacklife BC webbing, "HighTech" (#137: 48 g/m, 39.2 kN, 4.6% @ 10 kN, carried over from SlackDB), was a mistake: it is this same product, whose page titles it "Lion Line - Hightech Webbing". Confirmed with the Mayor of Squamish. #137 was removed on 2026-10-08 and its figures discarded, not merged; its id is not reused.

name: Tube #1
description: High quality European made 25mm tubular nylon Slackline webbing in your custom length cut by the meter. The weave is custom made for us and uses a larger than normal amount of thread to create not only a smooth soft finish but is also thicker and stronger than other makes of tubular webbing on the market.

name: Verve Red
description: Our Verve slackline webbing is the red coloured counterpart to our classic White Magic. The Verve offers a superior combination of low strain, high-strength, low weight and durability. The dynamic behaviour is even more defined and perfected compared to White Magic. The true red color (no surface coating) and the soft touch finishing the new accents.
notes: One row for Landcruising's 25 mm Verve, merged on 2026-10-07 from #151 'Verve 25mm' and the staged 'Verve 25mm Red'. Specs, price and description from the red Verve page (Wayback 2011-07-22): PES flat, MBS 31 kN, 7 % at 10 kN, 58 g/m, max. 10 kN pretension as a longline, made in Germany, 1.49 €/m (1.40 €/m from 100 m). The row previously carried the 2014 'Verve 25mm Slackline 30m loop' page (https://web.archive.org/web/20140902053505/http://www.landcruising-slacklines.de/en/shop/2-slackline-band/26-polyester/421-?vmcchk=1), which describes 'shiny yellow' webbing with av. >32 kN, min. 30 kN, 11 % at 10 kN, 59 g/m, 2-ply, 55.95 € for 30 m with a sewn loop; that page's blurb was: 'The 25 mm wide slackline with soft touch and extended stretch gives a fantastic dynamic pleasure, even on shorter lines.'

name: Reggae
description: The Reggae is a tubular webbing, stretchy and smooth. Historical slackline webbing. It's light and flexible, nice to carry in your backpack. Super fast, controlled and small jump movements are possible. Super suitable for deep and soft waves, bouncing and surfing. It has an incredible flex. The line appears like a wave during bouncing, which takes one away, floats and catches again with a soft move. It doesn’t shake even in case of strong oscillations. A special type of floating feeling.

name: Plasma
notes: Slack Inov / Spider 2026 datasheet (2026-09-02): MBS 80 mm diverter 40.0 kN; 3σ MBS weblock 32.6 kN; 3σ MBS sewn loop 34.8 kN; 3σ MBS linelock ring 34.8 kN; 3σ MBS after 6 months outdoor exposure 31.8 kN. The product page linked here previously (http://slack-inov.com/gb/webbing/92-flamme3-webbing) now 404s; the shops no longer carry it.

name: Firefly (phosphorescent)
description: The Firefly the only phosphorescent slackline webbing. You want to slackline in the dark, it will be perfect for your night pictures. Designed with the core + sheath technology, its weight of 56 g / m and its resistance of 30 kN make it versatile. Made in France

name: Pop-Art
description: New webbing, new weave, new vision; Pop-art is the trickline for your creative invention. With its unique design propel you in color. With a new weave even finer that gives a unique touch sensation and give you broad bounces. 100% Made in France

name: Project 44
description: The only braided tubular slackline webbing! Discover new sensations on a slackline, a webbing that has the ability to expand from 23mm to 40mm wide depending on the tension. Without any edge it will be ultra comfortable. It also has a resistance of 25 kN and strong resistance to abrasion with its braiding in double walls. Made in France, registered at INPI

name: Panda
description: Panda is flat polyester/dyneema blended webbing with low stretch, lightweight and high strength; the perfect for long and highlines at low tensions.

name: Joker
description: JOKER is an exceptional slackline webbing, designed for those who want more than just walking lines. Its hybrid construction (half polyester, half nylon) makes it a versatile option for fun training in the park, a medium stretch waterline, a bouncy highline for tricks, or for setting personal long-distance records. JOKER is the multi-purpose line to suit everyone needs.
notes: Slack Inov / Spider 2026 datasheet (2026-09-02): MBS 80 mm diverter 27.0 kN; 3σ MBS weblock 26.0 kN; 3σ MBS sewn loop 25.2 kN; 3σ MBS linelock ring 25.2 kN; 3σ MBS after 6 months outdoor exposure 21.4 kN; energy absorption capacity 2641 J/m; min rigging length 10 m highline / 50 m SPLIT 50 / 100 m SPLIT 100.

name: Y.a.w
description: The lightweight, yet very strong 25mm webbing is excellently suited as a lightweight travel slackline webbing, as a backup for highlining or as a rodeo webbing. With a meter weight of only 38g / m, it fits in every backpack traveling. Due to the low elongation of about 3% at 8kN, it can be clamped very easily.

name: Skyway
description: For those who want a comfortable strap, ideal for walking long distance in slackline. Its 11% at 10 kN will bring you a nice bounce. Its 27kN resistance and its core + sheath structure with round edges will make it safe. Made in France

name: Totally Tubular
description: Totally Tubular is loved by both professional and beginner slackliners alike. The affordability makes this webbing excellent for a begging looking to walking a short line. The stretchy, bounciness of the webbing is enjoyed by professionals around the world when doing bounce tricks. Affordable, lightweight, extreme stretching and bouncy, a great standard webbing.

name: FIREFOX
description: The polyamide (Nylon) tubular webbing that will make you rediscover the true capacity of the Bounce and with its 2.3% to 50 kg it will work even in rodeo. Its 26 kN resistance will make it safe for all slackline practice and will remain lightweight with a weight of 52 g / m. Thanks to its 2 black bands you will be able to make the dish easily. Made in France

name: S.O.S - Sunset Over Seas
description: The SOS Sunset Over Seas, the TENESTA® hybrid webbing with a 100% polyester sheath, fully developed with the ATA Slack team for the realization of Highline long distance. To reduce its wind resistance the width has been modified to reach 22 mm, while maintaining a resistance of more than 32 kN. Its low elasticity of 3.4% and its weight of 33.65 g / m make it perfect for long approaches. And the technology core + polyester sheath ensures a better resistance over time. Only the sewn loops offered in the S.O.S variations are compatible because they are made directly in the factory and certified for resistance. 100% made in France

description: Light and low stretch highline webbing. Ideal for long and stable highlines

description: Soft and stable nylon highline webbing. Ideal for long and stable highlines

name: SuperTape 19mm
description: Flat webbing made of robust and durable polyamide. Every marker fleck represents 5 kN minimum tensile strength.

description: Flat tubular webbing made of robust and durable polyamide. Every marker fleck represents 5 kN minimum tensile strength.

name: X-Tube 25mm
description: Flat tubular webbing made of robust and durable polyamide. Every marker fleck represents 5 kN minimum tensile strength.

name: Abysses Bounce
description: The ABYSSES slackline webbing is crafted for extreme bounce sessions. Bounce enthusiasts can now push their limits with vertical maneuvers.
notes: Slack Inov / Spider 2026 datasheet (2026-09-02): MBS 80 mm diverter 32.0 kN; 3σ MBS weblock 28.8 kN; 3σ MBS sewn loop 39.2 kN; 3σ MBS linelock ring 30.2 kN; 3σ MBS after 6 months outdoor exposure 26.5 kN; energy absorption capacity 4803 J/m; min rigging length 10 m highline / 50 m SPLIT 50 / 100 m SPLIT 100. The datasheet lists one "ABYSSES", which is this product. A duplicate row "Abysses" (#150, priced 2.30 EUR/m) was merged into this one on 2026-09-02 and removed from the catalogue.

name: Photon
description: The photon 100% polyester and with its weight of 54 g / m and its 24 kN of resistance, it will be ideal in longline waterline highline. Even with its reduced price, quality and resistance will be there. Made in France

name: Rubber Band PUR
description: A real oldschool nylon (polyamide) webbing with high stretch and incredible dynamics! Created to fulfill dreams of sky-high bounces and wild surfs. Do not get scared of high stretch demanding more effort while tensioning - end result is worth it. Rubber Band works perfectly at short highlines introducing more bouncy feeling also increasing their safety margin. The most fun however reveals at medium lengths even at low tension. Going even further, super long projects can be curiously demanding.

name: Levitation
description: Light, two-tone polyester webbing. Easy to tension due to low stretch, but with a pleasant bounce. Levitation works great as the first longline up to 100 m. Alternatively, it can be used as a lightweight backup for projects where low weight matters more.

name: MOTM light
description: MOTM light is a 19mm wide ultralight tubular nylon webbing for the most lightweight travel kits. A weight of only 33g/m and high stretch bounce makes it a fun companion for your travels to the farthest places on planet earth.
notes: Specs from raed webbing manual Annex A.

name: Ocean
description: EQB Ocean is a high-stretch webbing with soft edges. Ideal highline companion for bouncy sessions.

name: Skye2
description: A lightweight 3ton polyester webbing that boasts with “core/weave” and extra rounded edges. No detail was omitted.

name: LSDTube
description: It feels like you are walking on the rainbow with the brand new LSDTube! Guaranteed maximum playfulness, both visually and performance of the slackline. This light and stretchy slackline is multifunctional as it is ideal to let off steam creatively with hard bouncing tricks and surfing sessions or if you just want to have a relaxing session, doing meditative walks.

name: Spider Silk MK3
description: Super lightweight hitech webbing. Great for monster lines or an ultralight backup

name: Dyneemite
description: BOOM. Your old personal best just got blasted: Walking this webbing feels like cheating - on speed... Dyneemite is an ultralight Dyneema-Polyester hybrid webbing for your BIG highline projects.
notes: Specs from raed webbing manual Annex A.

name: Aurora
description: Aurora makes you shine like magic in the sky. This is the most fun, bounciest, softest, roundest polyester highline webbing we've ever made. The puffed edges feel like velvet during catches. And the 31 kN MBS gives you the comfort of high safety even in your craziest bounce tricks. Shine in the sky!
notes: Specs from raed webbing manual Annex A. loop MBS 26 kN; ISA strength class B

name: ReBL
description: The Sigma ReBL is our ultimate development of the longline webbings - a high-quality highline webbing with an outstanding weight-to-strength ratio. Densely and robustly woven, very easy to rig thanks to its low stretch. Comfortable edges, light and still extremely strong. 34 kN breaking strength at only 56 g/m: that is why the ReBL is our webbing for long and high lines.

name: Lift 2be
description: Super High Stretch Tubular Webbing. Up your bounce-trick game to 9000!

name: Candy
description: A delicacy for the picky ones, that´s Candy - a lightweight low stretch 3,5ton polyester webbing that boasts with “core/weave” and extra rounded edges. No detail was omitted.

name: Eclipse
description: Eclipse is black - of course. It's a lightweight polyester webbing with 16 kN breaking strength and mid stretch properties. So this is an ideal webbing for small packing travel lines, rodeo lines and soft releases.
notes: Specs from raed webbing manual Annex A.

name: Jelly
description: Light, low stretch, soft, tubular polyester. Ideal for park lines and low tension longlines

name: Green 20
description: Ultra-soft, super stretch nylon webbing. Ideal for long and stable highlines

name: Sonic Light
description: Sonic Light is a lightweight polyamide webbing in a modern and comfortable design. Aki Sonic Light has a round, very finely woven and padded edge design, which ensures a noticeable softness. The securing edge yarn on one side was kept very small in size and pulled around to the side, so it is extremely minimally noticeable. Sonic Light is a slackline webbing with a little more stretch for a wide range of uses.

name: Sky Diamond
description: 17 mm webbing in SPLITS, specific for very long highline set-ups.
notes: Slack Inov / Spider 2026 datasheet (2026-09-02): MBS 80 mm diverter 32.0 kN; 3σ MBS sewn loop 31.0 kN; 3σ MBS linelock ring 19.0 kN; 3σ MBS after 6 months outdoor exposure 30.45 kN; energy absorption capacity 1405 J/m; min rigging length 0 m highline / 108 m SPLIT 50 / 194 m SPLIT 100.

description: 50mm double tubular tape filled with polyester fibers, sewn padding. Rigged untensioned like a rodeo line for acro/yoga use. 8m or 12m.
notes: No MBS published — rigged at very low load by design.

description: Low stretch 37mm park/longline webbing tensionable to 100m with ratchets alone. 1-meter distance markers.

description: Versatile 37mm low-stretch webbing usable as both longline and trickline. whiteGrip surface for wet-condition grip.

name: GREEN T20
description: 20mm soft-stretch nylon webbing with colored sublimation print, sold in 20m lengths. Travel line or home rodeoline.

name: LEMON HAZE
description: 20mm tubular highline backup webbing blending UHMWPE (Dyneema) white fibers with coloured PES fibers. High stretch, anti-slip inside the weblock and underfoot, and narrow enough to cut wind reaction ~1.5x vs 25mm. Designed, tested and made in Italy.
notes: MBS 32 kN confirmed by owner. Datasheet (slacklines.us, 2026-08): thickness 2 mm, 39.5 g/m, suggested length 50-1000 m, suggested backup length 11% longer than the main line, energy absorption capacity 2261 J/m, anti-twist black-and-green stripes, made in Italy. MBS by termination: 28 kN over an 80mm diverter; 3-sigma 31 kN sewn loop, 25 kN Zenlock, 32.7 kN Zenlock 1.5 wraps, 34 kN Zenlock 2x wraps, 27 kN Diamondlock, 22 kN in weblock after 6 months perma-rig sun exposure. Sold by the meter (USD 3.90/m, SKU HWS02) or pre-made SPLIT50 (USD 195, LWS02.S50) / SPLIT100 (USD 389, HWS02.S100) with sewn loops both ends. Slack Inov / Spider 2026 datasheet (2026-09-02): MBS 80 mm diverter 31.0 kN; 3σ MBS weblock 25.0 kN; 3σ MBS sewn loop 31.0 kN; 3σ MBS linelock ring 27.0 kN; 3σ MBS after 6 months outdoor exposure 22.0 kN; energy absorption capacity 2261 J/m; min rigging length 15 m highline / 50 m SPLIT 50 / 100 m SPLIT 100.

Made in Italy/France. Weight/thickness from product copy. Slack Inov / Spider 2026 datasheet (2026-09-02): MBS 80 mm diverter 28.0 kN; 3σ MBS weblock 26.0 kN; 3σ MBS sewn loop 27.0 kN; 3σ MBS linelock ring 27.0 kN; 3σ MBS after 6 months outdoor exposure 22.0 kN; energy absorption capacity 1938 J/m; min rigging length 31 m highline / 61 m SPLIT 50 / 106 m SPLIT 100.

name: Dyneemite PRO
description: 19mm slim, 34 kN, ultralight 22 g/m Dyneema/polyester blend. Slimmer than Dyneemite but stronger and thicker at the same weight; the 19mm width significantly reduces wind drag on big lines compared to 25mm webbing. Recommended highline length up to 200m.
notes: Specs from raed webbing manual Annex A. WLL1 6.8 kN (SF=5), WLL2 11.3 kN (SF=3); recommended weblock RigLock 19mm. ISA certification as Type A highline webbing is INTENDED but not yet granted — manufacturer states it is pending the final production batch, so isa_certified stays false. Not on the live raed-sports.com shop except as used stock; product_url is the last Wayback capture of Raed's page (2025-09-16), where it sold new at 3.99 EUR/m.

name: Jelly PRO Classic
description: Fluffy and playful highline webbing. Ideal for easy to rig, but fun to walk park lines and highlines
notes: Jelly, Jelly PRO Classic and Jelly PRO Desert are three distinct products. Classic and Desert share an identical published spec sheet and stretch curve — they differ by colourway — but are sold and tracked separately.

name: Yolo T1
description: The first highline webbing designed and made in Mexico, by Mexican highliners. 100% polyester with a tubular construction and padded edges — easy to tension like polyester, with the playful dynamism of a tubular weave, and added comfort when rigging, walking or catching the line. Well suited to park use and to highlines of 60m or more. Colours were chosen from available pre-dyed fibres to minimise water use in manufacturing.
notes: Specs from the manufacturer (translated from Spanish): MBS 26.5 kN, recommended WLL 5.3 kN, elasticity 5% @5kN and 10.5% @10kN, 58.5 g/m, 3mm thick, PES. Width 25mm confirmed by owner. Also sold as a 100m piece with sewn ends.

name: Xiui T1
description: A light, soft tubular nylon webbing with dynamic rebound, designed by Geko Slacklines for those after a lively but stable feel on slackline or highline. Suited to flowing crossings, training and versatile rigging, and primarily to freestyle. Compatible with 1" (25mm) slackline and highline systems; usable as highline main or backup, and for longline.
notes: Specs from the manufacturer (translated from Spanish): 25mm tubular polyamide (nylon), 56 g/m, MBS 25 kN, elongation 8–10% @10kN (midpoint 9% recorded), continuous tubular weave. Manufacturer states the webbing corresponds to ISA Type C with a maximum 180 days of accumulated sun exposure, but also that it is NOT certified as PPE — treated as not ISA-certified. Retire if cut, severely abraded or discoloured.

name: Flama
description: Slackhouse's freestyle webbing, designed specifically for bouncing with slackline bungees. High strength and durability at a reduced weight, tuned over many iterations for a long, smooth bounce with explosive power. Paired with a lightweight backup such as Tiger webbing or Aero HMPE rope it forms Slackhouse's top-end freestyle set.
notes: Manufacturer specs (slackhouseshop.pl): 20 mm flat polyamide (nylon), 3.20 mm thick, 52 g/m, MBS 23 kN, sewn-loop MBS 20 kN, WLL 5 kN, made in Poland. Slackhouse recommends bungee model v5 below 50 m, v6 for 50–60 m and v6+ above 60 m, tensioned to about 2.4 kN. No stretch curve is published for Flama. Price is per metre (7.00 PLN/m on the Polish shop; the English shop quotes EUR).

name: Tiger
description: Ultralight UHMWPE longline/highline webbing at under 30 g/m. Its very low stretch makes tensioning the longest projects efficient, while the reduced 21.5 mm width cuts wind exposure and softens the edges. Available in orange or black, and also a popular lightweight backup for freestyle sets.
notes: Manufacturer specs (slackhouseshop.pl): 21.5 mm flat UHMWPE, 2.5 mm thick, 29.8 g/m, MBS 30 kN, sewn-loop MBS 30 kN, WLL 8 kN, elongation 1.9 % @ 5 kN and 2.8 % @ 10 kN, backup +7 %, made in China. Sold as 50 m or 100 m sewn segments (ST loops with an integrated soft thimble by default, or flat FL loops). Not compatible with standard weblocks or with rubber-jaw grips (too slippery) — anchor via the sewn loops or a Petram Simplex-type device with a double wrap. UHMWPE melts at 140–150 °C, so friction damage develops faster than on PA/PES. Manufacturer caps service life at 5 years and advises against permanent installs as a mainline; recommended as a mainline only from ~150 m. The prose description quotes 2.4 % @ 5 kN / 2.9 % @ 10 kN — the spec table values recorded here are the manufacturer's tabulated figures. Price is per metre at the 100 m segment (13.00 PLN/m); longer orders are cheaper per metre.

name: Rubbit
description: A modern, super-stretchy tubular nylon webbing built for big freestyle moves. The dense weave feels soft underfoot while still giving the grip needed for tricks, and the 'Pillowed Edges' rounded construction stays comfortable to catch late in a session.
notes: Manufacturer specs (slackhouseshop.pl), version MK II: 26 mm tubular polyamide (nylon), 3.35 mm thick, 61.1 g/m, MBS 24 kN, sewn-loop MBS 22.4 kN, T-loop MBS 19.5 kN, WLL 6 kN, backup +15–20 %, made in Poland. Elongation is published as 12.3 % @ 5 kN and 17.7 % @ 10 kN; the curve stored here was digitised from Slackhouse's own stretch chart and reads 12.29 % / 17.70 % at those points. Also offered through the shop's 'Rubbit X-Type' configurator (X-type stitching), which is the same webbing, not a separate product. Price is the per-metre rate (9.60 PLN/m).

name: Slamina
description: Jaan Roose's signature high-performance trickline webbing, built for extremely dynamic acrobatics. An innovative printed line design gives high visibility and a distinctive feel.
notes: Sold as a 25 m piece. Published specs: 50 mm wide, 25 m long, MBS 30 kN, 2.2 kg packed weight, made in China. Fibre is not published by Gibbon or any retailer checked (Gibbon's other 50 mm tricklines are polyester), so the material is recorded as Other rather than guessed; g/m weight is likewise unpublished — the 2.2 kg figure is the packed shipping weight. Listed by Slackhouse (slackhouseshop.pl), which names Gibbon as the producer; imported under Gibbon rather than the shop, per the master list's retailer rule. Discontinued: absent from Gibbon's own shop and sold out at Slackhouse. Price is 299.00 PLN for the 25 m piece (11.96 PLN/m).

name: Brasileirinha (Nylon)
description: Bera's flat nylon all-rounder — strong, very dynamic and aimed at walkers who like a loose, lively line. Intended for longline, highline, rodeoline and waterline use.
notes: Manufacturer specs (beraadventure.com.br): 100 % polyamide (nylon), 25 mm flat, MBS 28 kN, WLL 5.6 kN (5 kN with a sewn eye), safety factor 5:1, stretch 12 % @ 10 kN, 60 g/m. Sold in 30/50/75/100/200 m lengths, in white and purple (roxa); the 50 m white piece is the reference row here. Price is per metre derived from the base length prices (R$ 400 / 50 m = 8.00 BRL/m); sewn-eye options add a surcharge.

name: Sky 2.0
description: Flat double-face polyester webbing woven from coloured polyester yarns, with high resistance to heat, UV and abrasion — Bera's pick for longlines and highlines. Sold in a wine-and-lilac colourway.
notes: Manufacturer specs (beraadventure.com.br): 100 % polyester, 25 mm flat double-face, MBS 35 kN, WLL 7 kN (5 kN with a sewn eye), safety factor 5:1, stretch 6.7 % @ 10 kN, 68 g/m. Predominant colours wine (vinho) and lilac. Sold in 30–200 m lengths; price per metre derived from the base length prices (R$ 350 / 50 m = 7.00 BRL/m). Distinct product from Sky 2.0 3D.

name: Sky 2.0 3D
description: The 3D-weave version of Bera's flat double-face Sky 2.0 polyester webbing — same heat, UV and abrasion resistance for longlines and highlines, in a white line with royal-blue and orange detailing.
notes: Manufacturer specs (beraadventure.com.br): 100 % polyester, 25 mm flat double-face 3D weave, MBS 33 kN, WLL 6.6 kN (5 kN with a sewn eye), safety factor 5:1, stretch 6.7 % @ 10 kN, 68 g/m. Predominant colour white with royal blue and orange details. Sold in 30–200 m lengths; price per metre derived from the base length prices (R$ 275 / 50 m = 5.50 BRL/m). Separate product from Sky 2.0 — lower MBS and a different weave.

name: Steel Cable
notes: Specs confirmed direct by Wall Ace (2026-09-10), superseding the announcement-post figures this entry was first built from: 25 mm, 36 g/m (not 27.5), MBS 27 kN. That MBS is the strength of the webbing terminated in loops - the way the product is actually sold and used - not a raw tensile figure for the band, and it is what the derived classification is computed from. Construction is a Dyneema centre with purple nylon edges. Production has stopped - the maker's own summary of this webbing and its thinner twin, Duct Tape, is "comfortable and cheap but not exactly high tech" - so active is false, and there is no product page (product_url null). The announcement post this entry was first built from, which had a first length reaching Australia and a main shipment a month out, described the end of the run rather than the start of one. Sizing: sold only as a complete highline kit, and always in the same two segments - a 75 m main and an 83 m backup (4 loops included), at an indicative, not-yet-finalised ~580 AUD for the kit. No priceMeter is recorded: `price` on a webbing is per metre, and dividing an unfinalised kit price by 158 m would invent a number the maker has not quoted. Stretch is recorded as null, deliberately. The maker's own account is that it is very hard to put one figure on: roughly 5% between 1 and 3 kN, then about 2.5% more between 3 and 5 kN - so on the order of 7.5% total at 5 kN - with the curve flattening off as load climbs further. That is a shape described from memory, not a measured curve, and the earlier single 2.5% at 5 kN point taken from the announcement post was wrong by a factor of three. A wrong curve on a chart is worse than no curve. Photos: the two Wall Ace webbing images we hold are shared between Steel Cable and Duct Tape. The products are the same weave in two thicknesses, and the maker's own view is that the same picture serves both - and that the one filed under Steel Cable may in fact be Duct Tape. Which image is which is not settled.

name: Axiom MK2
description: Affordable High Tech. Amazing for big gaps and backups for freestyle. Built for the body of a bigline, or as its backup, not for the hardware-handling ends.
notes: Manufacturer specs (balancecommunity.com): 18.4 mm × 2.5 mm, 31 g/m, MBS 39 kN, sewn-loop MBS 46 kN, WLL 13 kN, 100 % UHMWPE (HMPE) in a flat single-layer, single-zone weave. The current production batch (W26DZ, Aug 2026) measured 39.93 kN MBS and 46.85 kN sewn loop; BC restates those per batch, so the catalogue records the published nominal 39 kN. Optimum tension 1.0–4.5 kN, preferred lengths 200 m+, backup 7 % longer than the main — HMPE creeps, so a permarig main grows into that backup. ISA stretch 1.25 % @ 5 kN and 2.08 % @ 10 kN (standardised ISA method, 200 mm gauge); BC's stretch chart publishes only those two points, so REVISIT and replace this two-point curve if a full load–elongation curve is released. BC labels it highline-approved; that is the maker's own statement, not an ISA certification. Hardware compatibility is the caveat that defines this webbing: NOT compatible with any weblock (slips single-wrapped in all of them, bends the front pin from about 24 kN double-wrapped) except a MightyLock on a Van Beest 1/2" 2-tonne shackle, double-wrapped, pin side; not compatible with any webbing grip (micro grips slip at 0.2 kN, full-size at 7 kN, Wafer XL at 12 kN). Anchor it on its sewn loops, with a soft thimble under any soft connector — without one the loop loses up to 50 % of its strength. Sewn loops are Pattern 504 (160 × 16 mm, 200 stitches) sewn with Dyneema thread; naked, sleeveless loops are also offered. Price is the custom per-metre rate ($2.90/m, on sale at $2.61 as of 2026-09-19); cut lengths are 50 / 60 / 100 m. Woven in China; measured, cut and sewn in Colorado. Released 2026-09-17 (Shopify listing publish date). Supersedes the original Axiom (id 213), which BC's own stretch comparison now flags as legacy.
